mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened discounting of future cash flows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS rises above its 6-month moving average, labor market strength is interpreted as supporting corporate earnings growth, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with PAYEMS crossing above its 6-month average (R² < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in HOUST (industrial production) for three consecutive months signal accelerating demand, which precedes a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite the 3-month moving average of HOUST shows upward momentum (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production) below its 12-month moving average, accompanied by a simultaneous drop in GDPC1 (goods demand), predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return via supply shock.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero when both INDPRO and GDPC1 are below their 12-month averages (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months, the policy rate is expected to stay low, supporting equity valuations and a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE remains below 4% for the next 60 days (out-of-sample).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in RSAFS (retail sales) above its 3-month high, followed by a rise in PAYEMS, indicates consumer and labor momentum that drives a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
regime_hint: rebound in consumer and labor activity
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) when both RSAFS and PAYEMS cross their 3-month highs simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL (CPI) below 2% for four consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to exhibit a negative 60-day forward return as inflation expectations cool and rates may hold steady.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2 AND CPIAUCSL_{t-1} >= 2 AND CPIAUCSL_{t-2} >= 2 AND CPIAUCSL_{t-3} >= 2 AND CPIAUCSL_{t-4} >= 2
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for the full horizon (contradicting the mechanism).

mechanism_narrative: When both INDPRO and GDPC1 show simultaneous declines for two consecutive months, it signals a dual supply contraction, resulting in a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO_t < INDPRO_{t-1} AND INDPRO_{t-1} < INDPRO_{t-2} AND GDPC1_t < GDPC1_{t-1} AND GDPC1_{t-1} < GDPC1_{t-2}
regime_hint: dual contraction in output and demand
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative when both INDPRO and GDPC1 show the described declines (p > 0.05).
